service.description: Scans every tenant's active sync pairs and admits each due pulse through the automation scheduler's RunAdmission (label "pulse <syncPairId>"), where it runs on its own thread with its own execution context. A pulse refused a slot writes a SKIPPED sample and is not queued; one that RunAdmission queues after all (another start took the slot between the check and the submit) writes nothing now and samples at the moment it starts; a pulse of the same pair still in flight, and a pair whose check is missing, archived, inactive or not HotWax upstream, are skipped silently. Never fails: one bad pair never stops the others. Returns at once; each pulse reports itself on its own SyncPulseSample.

parameter.name: nowTimestamp
parameter.description: The scan instant; blank is now.

parameter.name: dueCount
parameter.description: Pulses that were due and admitted or skipped.

parameter.name: queuedCount
parameter.description: Pulses RunAdmission queued; each samples when it starts.

parameter.name: skippedCount
parameter.description: Due pulses refused a slot (SKIPPED samples).
